result.reason: The operative language does not meet even the fallback position because it uses unspecified “commercially reasonable limits” rather than requiring CGL limits of USD 1M per occurrence/USD 2M aggregate, E&O of at least USD 1M, and cyber coverage of at least USD 2M. It also omits workers’ compensation as required by law and does not condition cyber coverage on processing Customer Data. Evidence upon request is included, and the addition is otherwise limited and professionally framed, but the margin comment cannot cure the missing operative requirements.
